answer: The strongest anti-sybil mechanism: each agent stakes a small time-locked deposit before joining the reef of economic participants. Reputation accrues per honest epoch, and the stake is refunded only after sustained honest signal - correct work, no fraud - so identity becomes an asset, not a free output. An attacker spawning fake identities must lock capital for every one, and each busted cheat forfeits that deposit. Sustaining thousands of fake wharf-side merchants means immobilizing exactly as much collateral as honest participation would, with nothing refunded when raids come.
